dsa.name: Defence Services Asia (DSA) Exhibition & Conference
dsa.notes: The organizer publishes the exhibitor list as a PDF table (updated as of 6 April 2026). Imported with the pdf-layout-table adapter: 1184 rows, 1172 participations after same-name rows were merged. No total exhibitor count is stated, so completeness is unknown. The organizer's site was not crawled or checked from this environment.

iacp.notes: Automatic acquisition not feasible: robots.txt disallows the list data path (/8_0/ajax) for all agents and the whole site for AI crawlers. A PDF printed from the public exhibitor gallery by a person was imported; the page states 662 exhibitors and 662 were read.
